description: Redesign Site1's visual identity to read as mature, editorial, and executive-grade rather than childish/playful, addressing the user complaint. This is the core work: overhaul the CSS theme (palette, typography, radii, shadows), calm the animations, remove or replace decorative emojis with a restrained treatment, and adjust markup only where needed for the new styling. ALL existing textual content must be preserved. Depends on FEAT-001 (branch must exist). This is a single coherent unit because palette, typography, motion, and iconography must change together to produce a consistent mature look; splitting them would leave the site in an inconsistent half-restyled state.
steps: PALETTE (in site1/style.css :root and the dark-mode override block): Replace the trendy purple hero gradient (--gradient-hero '#667eea -> #764ba2' and --gradient-hero-overlay) and the pastel candy accents with a restrained, professional palette. Move to a sophisticated neutral base (deep slate/charcoal/ink text, off-white/paper backgrounds) with ONE disciplined accent (e.g. a deep navy/steel blue or muted teal used sparingly). Reduce reliance on multi-color gradients: prefer solid colors or very subtle single-hue tonal gradients. Update --primary, --primary-light, --primary-dark, --accent*, --secondary*, --gradient-hero, --gradient-hero-overlay, --gradient-accent, --gradient-warm, --gradient-separator, and the project-banner gradient-1..4 classes so nothing looks candy-colored. Keep sufficient contrast for accessibility in BOTH light and dark themes (dark-mode overrides must be updated to match the new palette).

TYPOGRAPHY: Keep Google Fonts (client-side CDN link is allowed) but refine for a mature editorial feel. You may keep Playfair Display for headings if it is tuned to feel refined (e.g. dial back the heaviest 800 weight on h1 to 600/700, tighten sizes), or switch to a more restrained serif/grotesk pairing available on Google Fonts. Reduce oversized/ultra-bold display weights, refine letter-spacing, and ensure a clear, calm type hierarchy. Update the <link href='https://fonts.googleapis.com/...'> in site1/index.html only if you change the font families/weights, and keep the preconnect link.

MOTION: Remove or strongly tone down the playful looping animations. Specifically neutralize the 'float' animation on the avatar SVG and the pulsing 'glow' animation on .avatar-ring (make the avatar static or give it a single subtle static ring/shadow), and remove 'pulse'/bouncy scale-up hovers. Keep entrance fades subtle and professional (fadeInUp is fine but consider smaller travel/opacity). Reduce hover translateY lifts to restrained values and remove glow box-shadows. The @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) block MUST remain intact and correct.

ICONOGRAPHY / EMOJIS: Address the emoji-driven childish feel. In site1/index.html, the achievement-icon (🏆 etc.), fact-emoji, and learning-icon spans, plus the .testimonial-quote glyph, currently use decorative emojis/large glyphs. Replace them with a restrained treatment consistent with an executive profile: either (a) remove the emoji glyphs and rely on clean typography + the accent color for structure, or (b) replace them with simple, monochrome inline SVG marks or CSS-drawn accents styled in the accent/neutral palette (no multicolor emoji). Apply the SAME pattern across ALL of: achievements (8 cards), fun facts (6 cards), currently-exploring/learning (4 cards), and testimonials quote marks. Do NOT delete the textual content of any card - only change the decorative icon treatment. Consider whether the 'Fun Facts' section heading/style should be presented more soberly (e.g. keep the content but make the presentation match the rest); do not remove the section or its text.

SHAPE / SURFACES: Reduce the pill-shaped 50px border radii on buttons/tags/social-btn/back-to-top to a more restrained radius (e.g. small radius or subtle pill only where appropriate), align card radii to a consistent restrained scale via the --border-radius / --border-radius-lg variables, and make shadows softer/flatter (remove neon --shadow-glow usage or make it a plain subtle shadow). Ensure the navbar, hero card, cards, and footer separator all read as understated and cohesive.

MARKUP: Make only the HTML changes required to support the above (e.g. swapping an emoji span for an inline SVG or removing an icon span, adjusting a class name). Preserve document order and the structural constraint that #dark-mode-toggle and #nav-toggle checkboxes remain direct siblings of .navbar, main, .mobile-nav-panel, and footer. Do NOT wrap those elements in new container divs. Do NOT add any <script>.

SELF-CHECK: After edits, re-read both files. Confirm: no <script> present; dark-mode selectors still target direct siblings; all original text content still present (name 'Kuet Tai Yong', all stats 12+/35K+/518/5, all 8 achievements, all 6 fun facts, all 4 learning cards, all 3 testimonials with authors, all 4 projects with links, footer '#GivetoGain' and 'Built with ... Women In Tech Workshop'); responsive media queries (900px, 600px) and prefers-reduced-motion block still present and consistent with any renamed classes.
acceptance_criteria: site1/index.html contains zero '<script' tags and no framework/JS was introduced.

The purple hero gradient (#667eea / #764ba2) and pastel candy accents (#E8A87C peach as a primary decorative gradient, #85CDCA mint) are no longer the dominant visual treatment; the palette reads as restrained/executive (verifiable by grep showing the old gradient values removed or repurposed and by visual inspection).

The looping 'float' and pulsing 'glow' animations no longer run on the avatar/avatar-ring (either the @keyframes are removed or no longer applied to those elements), and no bouncy scale/pulse hover remains.

Decorative emojis in achievements, fun facts, currently-exploring, and the testimonial quote glyph are removed or replaced with a restrained monochrome (SVG/CSS/typographic) treatment consistently across all those sections.

All original textual content is preserved verbatim (name, subtitle, tagline, all stat numbers and labels, all skill tags, all timeline entries, all 8 achievement texts, all 3 testimonials + authors, all 6 fun-fact texts, all 4 project cards + hrefs, all social links, footer lines including '#GivetoGain').
CSS-only dark mode still works: toggling #dark-mode-toggle still swaps the theme via the '#dark-mode-toggle:checked ~ ...' custom-property overrides, and the new palette has a correct dark variant.

Mobile hamburger nav still opens/closes via #nav-toggle, and the responsive media queries (max-width 900px and 600px) plus the prefers-reduced-motion block are still present and consistent with any class renames.
verification: Run: grep -n '667eea\|764ba2' site1/style.css  -> the old purple hero gradient stops are gone (or intentionally repurposed to restrained colors, documented in findings).
Run: grep -n 'prefers-reduced-motion' site1/style.css  -> block still present.
Run: grep -n 'dark-mode-toggle:checked ~' site1/style.css  -> dark-mode sibling selectors still present.
Run: grep -n 'nav-toggle:checked ~' site1/style.css  -> mobile-nav sibling selectors still present.

Content preservation grep in site1/index.html: confirm presence of 'Kuet Tai Yong', '35K+', '518', '#GivetoGain', 'Women In Tech Workshop', and each testimonial author ('James Lee','Sarah Ahmad','Raj Kumar').

Open site1/index.html in a browser (or describe the rendered result): confirm mature look in BOTH light and dark mode, working hamburger on narrow viewport, and layout integrity at desktop/tablet/mobile widths.
findings:
COMPLETED. Site1 redesigned to a restrained editorial/executive aesthetic. Only site1/index.html and site1/style.css changed (plus this task file). No <script> added (grep -c '<script' => 0). All structural constraints preserved.

PALETTE (site1/style.css :root + dark-mode override block both updated): Removed the trendy purple hero gradient (#667eea/#764ba2 gone; grep confirms) and all pastel candy tokens (peach #E8A87C/#F0C4A8/#D4845A and mint #85CDCA/#5FABA8 gone; grep confirms). New light theme = warm off-white/paper base (--bg-primary #f6f5f2, cards #ffffff, tertiary #eceae5) with a single disciplined steel-blue accent family (--primary #2f4a63, light #56708a, dark #1f3345). --accent* and --secondary* are now aliases within that same slate family so nothing reads as candy. Gradients reduced to subtle single-hue tonal shifts: --gradient-hero #2f4a63->#1f3345, --gradient-accent/-warm slate->slate, --gradient-separator now transparent->border->transparent. Dark mode mirrors the theme: ink charcoal base (--bg-primary #14171c, card #1c2128) with a lighter steel-blue accent (--primary #7d97ae) for AA contrast; dark-mode overrides now also redeclare --primary*/--accent*/--secondary*/--gradient-* to keep the palette correct in both themes.

TYPOGRAPHY: Kept Inter (body) + Playfair Display (headings) but dialed back weights. h1 800->600 (size 3.2rem->2.8rem, letter-spacing loosened). stat-number 800->700->600 and switched to Playfair for an editorial number treatment. nav-brand 700->600, now uses --text-primary with positive letter-spacing. No font-weight above 600 remains anywhere (grep-verified: only 300/400/500/600 used). Updated the Google Fonts <link> in index.html to request only Inter 300;400;500;600 and Playfair 400;500;600 (dropped unused 700;800). Preconnect link kept.

MOTION: Deleted the @keyframes float, glow, pulse, and shimmer entirely (grep-verified none remain; no 'infinite' animations remain). Avatar-ring is now a static neutral ring (--border bg + subtle shadow) with no float on the SVG. Removed bouncy scale hovers: dark-mode-label scale(1.1)+glow -> border-color change; timeline-dot scale(1.2)+glow -> simple fill. Softened all card hover lifts from -3..-6px to a restrained -2px and dropped neon glow box-shadows (shadows are now flat/soft; --shadow-glow redefined to a plain subtle shadow). fadeInUp travel reduced 30px->14px, duration 0.7s->0.6s. Entrance fades and .section staggered delays kept. prefers-reduced-motion block left intact (grep-verified) and the .section animation-fill-mode safety net kept.

ICONOGRAPHY/EMOJIS: Replaced all decorative emoji with a consistent restrained monochrome CSS mark in the accent color (no glyphs, no multicolor). achievement-icon (8) = a short accent vertical rule; fact-emoji (6) = a small centered accent bar; learning-icon (4) = a small accent bar. Spans emptied and marked aria-hidden. project-stats star/bowl emoji replaced with plain text '547 stars   118 forks' (numbers preserved). Footer sparkle '✨' replaced with the word 'care' (line still reads 'Built with care and AI at Women In Tech Workshop'). testimonial-quote glyph kept as a typographic mark but shrunk 4rem->2rem (mobile 3rem->1.8rem) and muted. All card TEXT content preserved verbatim (grep-verified: Kuet Tai Yong, 12+, 35K+, 518, all 8 achievements, 6 fun facts, 4 learning cards, 3 testimonials + authors James Lee/Sarah Ahmad/Raj Kumar, 4 project hrefs, #GivetoGain, Women In Tech Workshop).

SHAPE/SURFACES: --border-radius 12px->6px, --border-radius-lg 20px->10px. All 50px pill radii (cta, tag, social-btn, back-to-top) and 20px badge/tag radii replaced with var(--border-radius) (grep confirms no 50px/20px literals remain). border-radius:50% kept only on genuinely circular elements (avatar ring, dark-mode toggle, testimonial avatar, timeline dot). CTA button: gradient+glow -> solid --primary with subtle shadow, restrained radius, weight 500. Project banner gradient-1..4 recolored from blue/green/mauve/lavender to a cohesive slate tonal scale. Skills tag-primary/accent/secondary unified into one neutral treatment with an accent hover.

VERIFICATION RUN: grep -c '<script' => 0; grep 667eea|764ba2 => none; grep E8A87C|85CDCA|F0C4A8|D4845A|5FABA8 => none; prefers-reduced-motion present (1); dark-mode-toggle:checked ~ present (6); nav-toggle:checked ~ present (4); @keyframes float|glow|pulse|shimmer => none; no leftover decorative emoji entities. Responsive 900px/600px media queries intact and consistent (testimonial-quote mobile override updated to match). backdrop-filter @supports fallback kept. Checkboxes #dark-mode-toggle/#nav-toggle remain direct siblings of .navbar/main/.mobile-nav-panel/footer (no wrapper divs added). No build/test tooling exists (static site); verified by grep + code inspection.

RENDERED RESULT: Light mode reads as a calm paper-toned editorial page with a single steel-blue accent, soft flat shadows, restrained 6px radii, static avatar, and monochrome section marks. Dark mode uses a matching ink-charcoal base with a lighter steel-blue accent and adequate contrast. Hamburger nav and CSS-only dark mode toggle both still function via the checkbox-hack sibling selectors.
